summary: KEPCO filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing an English-language summary of its Korean quarterly business report for the period from January 1, 2026 to June 30, 2026, covering company overview, 169 consolidated subsidiaries, and director appointments. Board changes were ordinary replacements of directors whose terms expired at scheduled appointments on April 27, May 8, May 27, and June 17, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. The filing represents ordinary periodic reporting for a foreign private issuer, offering no event-driven angle or risk-arb catalyst.
